name: Squrve-Benchmarks
description: A collection of benchmarking tasks (Squrve Benchmarks) intended to evaluate various model capabilities across a set of curated problems; it aggregates tasks that test reasoning, classification and generative outputs. The suite is intended for quick multi-task evaluation and comparative analyses across model families. Task composition and difficulty vary across included sub-benchmarks.
reputation: A small, user-contributed benchmark collection with modest adoption and limited citations in the wider community.
